title: Object index cache can be redirected through symlinked .boreal/cache
description: ObjectDirBorealStore realpath-checks objects, event log, and lock paths, but omits objectIndexFile. ObjectReadIndex then mkdir/open SQLite at .boreal/cache/index.sqlite, so a symlinked cache directory can redirect generated database writes outside the workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Object store safety checks include objectIndexFile or its parent before any SQLite open/write.
Symlinked .boreal/cache escapes are rejected for read and write index paths.
Regression tests prove .boreal/cache -> outside does not create or open outside/index.sqlite.
closedReason: Cache symlink escape is rejected before any SQLite existence check or write.
